h2: Pool Cleaning Kerobokan & Umalas – Villa Pool Care
intro: Looking for reliable pool cleaning in Kerobokan & Umalas? Bali Fix handles one-off cleans and green-pool recovery across Kerobokan Kelod, Umalas, and Batu Belig — skimming, brushing, vacuuming, filter backwash, and full water balance in a single visit. Send a few photos on WhatsApp and you'll get a quote before anyone rolls up.

sections.h3: Why Pools Here Need More Than a Quick Skim
sections.text: In Kerobokan and Umalas, villas tend to be larger with bigger gardens, which means more organic debris — leaves, pollen, insects — landing in your pool daily. The high groundwater table here, similar to nearby Canggu, pushes moisture into drainage lines and can introduce algae spores through irrigation overflow. Older properties in Kerobokan Kelod sit beside newer builds, so you'll see both worn tile grout and fresh concrete dust settling on water surfaces. A regular skim-and-brush cycle keeps pace with that mix.

sections.h3: Typical Jobs We Pick Up Around Umalas & Batu Belig
sections.text: Most calls from this stretch fall into a handful of patterns. A family hosting guests for the weekend needs a full clean: skimming, brushing every surface, vacuuming the floor, backwashing the filter, and checking chlorine and pH. Green or cloudy water after a wet season is another common request; we treat it as a recovery job rather than a quick top-up. Waterline tiles in older Kerobokan Kelod villas often carry mineral stains that need dedicated scrubbing before they set permanently.

sections.h3: What to Send on WhatsApp Before Booking
sections.text: Before booking, snap two or three photos: one wide shot of the whole pool showing colour and clarity, one close-up of any stained tile or algae patch, and one of the filter housing if reachable. Add a short line — 'water turned green after rain' or 'guests arriving Thursday.' Send those over WhatsApp and we'll reply with a quote tailored to what the job actually needs. Pricing depends on pool size, current water condition, and whether a full chemical reset is involved.

sections.h3: Keeping Your Pool Clear Between Visits
sections.text: Because Kerobokan and Umalas sit between Seminyak's traffic and Canggu's density, your pool takes a different kind of hit — less dust than the beach strip but more leaf litter from mature gardens. A simple weekly routine helps: skim the surface each morning, run the pump for at least four hours, and backwash the filter once a month even if pressure looks fine. After heavy rain, check that irrigation overflow isn't channeling into the basin; the high water table here makes that easier than you'd expect.

faq.q: Do you handle green-pool recovery in one visit?
faq.a: In most cases yes — we shock-treat, brush, vacuum, backwash, and rebalance the water in a single session. If the algae load is severe we may recommend a second pass 48 hours later to confirm it's fully cleared.

faq.q: How do I get a price for my villa's pool?
faq.a: Send two or three photos (wide shot, any problem area, filter housing) plus a line about what's going on via WhatsApp. We'll come back with a quote based on pool size and condition — no fixed rate list.

faq.q: Can you clean the pool before guests arrive on short notice?
faq.a: Yes. Message us on WhatsApp with your date and a quick photo of the current state, and we'll confirm whether we can slot you in. The bigger the gap between now and arrival, the more thorough the prep we can do.
